findings.title: 401 Response Interceptor Redirects to Wrong URL
findings.description: The 401 response interceptor in adminService.js redirects to /admin instead of /admin/login, causing a redirect loop: /admin/projects → /admin → /admin/login.
findings.impact: Every 401 response causes unnecessary navigation chaining with UI flicker. Direct redirect to /admin/login is correct.

findings.title: Missing Messages CRUD Export in adminService.js
findings.description: The design specifies that getMessages() and deleteMessage() should be exported from adminService.js, but they only exist in api.js which uses the wrong token key ("token" instead of "adminToken"). DashboardPage imports from the wrong service.
findings.fix: Add getMessages() and deleteMessage() exports to adminService.js using adminAPI. Update DashboardPage and MessagesPage imports to use adminService instead of api.js.
findings.impact: Messages API calls use public token instead of admin token, causing failures if token lifetimes differ. Inconsistent admin token handling.

findings.title: Inconsistent Error Handling in DashboardPage
findings.description: DashboardPage uses a hardcoded error message instead of parseErrorMessage() utility as specified in the design. All pages should use parseErrorMessage() for consistent error extraction and user-friendly messages.
findings.fix: Replace toast.error("Failed to load dashboard data") with toast.error(parseErrorMessage(error)). Add import for parseErrorMessage from adminHelpers.
findings.impact: Inconsistent error handling makes debugging harder and users don't see detailed error information. Violates design's stated consistency pattern.

findings.title: Unused State Variable in AdminLayout
findings.description: adminUsername state is initialized but hardcoded to "Admin" and never updated. The state is unnecessary.
findings.fix: Replace useState with a simple constant: const adminUsername = "Admin";
findings.impact: Minor code complexity. Not a blocker; revert to useState later if dynamic username loading is needed.

findings.title: Missing Defensive Error Handling in AdminRoute
findings.description: AdminRoute checks localStorage directly without try-catch. While extremely unlikely to fail, defensive programming is a best practice.
findings.fix: Wrap localStorage access in try-catch block (optional improvement, not blocking).
findings.impact: Extremely minor; existing code is acceptable and works in all supported browsers.
